## Summary

OLKIL (also searched as OLKIL IDE, OLKIL AI code editor) is a professional desktop IDE with built-in AI coding assistance. It helps developers write, refactor, debug, and ship software faster. Version 1.3.6 is available as a free Windows download. Developers commonly evaluate it alongside other AI code editors such as Cursor AI, Trae and Windsurf.
